title: Rupture de régénération
player_copy_markdown:
**Rupture de régénération — Rang 11**

*Une trame occulte entrave les chairs et les circuits. Les blessures restent ouvertes, les réparations n’aboutissent plus.*

**Effet actuel**

- Vie récupérée par soins, régénération et réparations : **0 PV**.
- Durée : **5 tours**.
- Portée : **5 cases**.
- Chance d’application sur la cible : **86,5 %**.

**Prochain rang — 12 · 1 point de compétence**

- Chance d’application sur la cible : **86,8 %**.

**Coût : 13 énergie · Recharge : 6 tours.**

Cible : un hostile visible en ligne de vue.

Les PV déjà présents et la récupération d’énergie restent inchangés.

formulas.duration_turns: 3 + floor((effective_rank - 1) / 4) + min(3, floor(max(0, Intelligence - 5) / 20)); source proposal
formulas.application_chance_percent: clamp(100 * power / (power + max(1, occult_resistance)), 5, 95); source proposal
formulas.display_rounding: Exact fractions, nearest tenth displayed; source proposal

tooltip_format.target_specific_chance: Illustrative target resistance 25 disclosed outside tooltip; real displayed chance depends on target.
tooltip_format.exact_chance_ui_when_observation_access_: pending_separate_interface_review; no hidden target information policy changed

presented_conditions: One hostile visible in player line of sight within 5 cells; 0 HP restored by healing/regeneration/repairs; existing HP and energy recovery unchanged. Chance shown for fixed example resistance 25. Source all-target-nature direction preserved.
unshown_rules_approval: Full-rank curves, resistance formula, exact turn ordering, modifier/snapshot timing, reapplication, self/allied/passive source classification, maximum HP changes, blocked-heal storage, future resurrection behavior, resisted-attempt expenditure and restricted-observation chance display remain pending where not previously presented/accepted.
active_weapon_requirement: none; techno-occult weakening is not a weapon-based attack
checks: Effective ranks 11/12 at Intelligence 10 both give duration 5 turns, energy 13, cooldown 6, range 5.
Application power 160 -> 165; target resistance 25 gives exact chances 3200/37 -> 1650/19%, displayed 86.5 -> 86.8%.
Learned 9 -> 10 with fixed gear +2; learned cap respected; same target and attributes.
Next block shows only changing application chance; constant healing block/duration/cost omitted there.
Source roleplay words preserved as one paragraph; healing, regeneration and repairs restore 0 HP; no removal of existing HP or interference with energy recovery.
No duplicated functional paragraph, rank breakdown, table/formula or ordinary action-time reminder.
HUD06 requirement retained: applied status in target analysis with effect values visible without drone. Native rendering remains pending.
